objectives: Memahami dan memakai complex sentence structures dalam kalimat dan teks berbahasa Inggris.
Menerapkan materi melalui contoh dan latihan singkat.
Memeriksa jawaban dan memperbaiki kesalahan umum.

blocks.text: Complex sentences menghubungkan klausa utama dan subordinat. Pelajari fungsi sebab, kontras, dan syarat agar argumen terbaca jelas.
Although + clause, main clause; because + clause, main clause; despite + noun/V-ing (bukan full clause).
Although the sample was small, the results were useful.
blocks.note: Contrast — Hasil berguna tetapi ada keterbatasan.

blocks.text: We delayed the trip because the road was closed.
Despite the rain, the match continued.

blocks.explanation: Despite tidak langsung diikuti klausa subject + verb.

blocks.text: Strategi latihan: baca seluruh kalimat, tandai petunjuk waktu atau hubungan makna, lalu pilih bentuk yang paling tepat. Setelah menjawab, jelaskan alasannya dengan kata-katamu sendiri.

practice.prompt: ___ the data were limited, the team published a cautious report.

choices: Because the survey was late, the report was delayed.
